children: Discussions about the U.K. strengthening its relations with the European Union could support sterling, Goldman Sachs forex strategists say in an outlook report. Sterling could receive a significant boost if a portion of the U.K.'s current trade hurdles with the EU are removed, the strategists say. "Continued positive soundbites could remain a source of sterling optimism next year," they say. Sterling falls 0.1% to a one-month low of $1.3192 against a stronger dollar, but rises 0.1% to a one-week high against the euro at 0.8334 per euro, according to LSEG. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
